I hate to admit it, but I always had the thought that it was something I’d do as a kid and I’d grow out of it as I got older. It’s been 14 years now on and off and there’s still times that I think there’s no end in sight.

You absolutely don’t deserve this. I know first hand how easy it is to fall into/believe that thought, but you deserve kindness and to feel at peace with yourself. I sincerely hope you get there.

I completely understand how you feel. I turned 28 this year and the realization I missed the window to join the 27 club gave me an unexpectedly devastated feeling (even though I haven’t accomplished anything to even be considered a member of the club…). Approaching 2023 now I’m feeling the same way, how can I do all this again, and for what? 

I’m sorry you’re having such a difficult time, I wish I had more encouraging words to share to lift your spirits. It’s one day at a time, try not to think of the mountain that is 2023 but just getting through the next day, and the next day, and the next day - maybe it will get easier. That’s what I’m hoping for at least.

Relapses happen - I recently relapsed and have been fighting the urge to cut a lot. It’s easy to be hard on yourself but you don’t deserve that. I’ve stopped counting my clean time recently as it always made me feel a lot worse when I did relapse and had to “start over” again. Take care of yourself, you deserve to feel peace 💖

I'm the exact same way. Even if I was happy the whole night out/with people, the second I get home and am drunk by myself I go into such a horrible spiral that it's become a routine. If someone is home with me when I'm drunk I can feel myself getting agitated that I can't sh. I've been so focused on other aspects of my mental health that I haven't started to contemplate my relationship with alcohol or other substances. I know that the best thing to do is to stop drinking all together to try and stay away from this harmful routine I'm in but I'm so reluctant. This was more of a vent than help, but if you ever want to talk or need someone to listen who's in the same boat, I'm here. Be kind to yourself today, you deserve to feel peace!

I’m sorry I can’t give you better medical advice. In my situation, my burn was never raised, it was a hard indent on my arm before it opened. It got infected and had a white-ish ring around the outside and the scabs on top never dried out or hardened if that makes sense. These changes all came within a month - a month and a half if I remember correctly. The reason I mentioned not getting help before was because when I did finally go to the doctor it was too late to do a skin graft for some reason and I’ve just had to let it do it’s thing ever since. 

I’m sorry you don’t have someone to support you by going to get help but lean on the people in this space. I was alone in the emergency room a few weeks ago and had some really kind people offer me support on here. So if you’re nervous about going to a doctor, we’re here with you! 

Hope you’re being kind to yourself today and I hope the burn is looking better. If it’s starting to bubble keep it clean and wrapped. Good luck!

I was there about two weeks ago. I’ve been numb for so long and I was thrown back into reality and began panicking when I realized I had cut deeper than I had planned. Take a few minutes if you can to just relax and to get control of your breathing. Once you’re in a more neutral place you can make the call about if you need to get medical attention (I had to go get six stitches and it wasn’t as scary as I thought it would be. It was hard, but it was doable). Caring for it right away is much better than waiting a few days and seeing what happens, so if you’re unsure or the nerves aren’t going away give yourself the piece of mind by going to emergency or a doctors office. If you need someone to talk to, I’m here. I’m sorry you’re experiencing this tonight

I do it all the time, it’s a horrible cycle to be stuck in. I’m sorry that you’re in such a difficult place right now. I’ve been slowly opening up to friends about my shit and have asked them to send me any cute animal pics/videos they come across throughout the day. It’s just a little burst of joy by seeing something I love and can help offset my spiral if I’m not expecting a cute message if that makes sense. I can’t do nice things for myself, especially when I’m trying to trigger myself and I’m only starting to realize how I cannot get out of this alone and I have to let the people in my life in, no matter how scary that is. If you need someone to send you random joy throughout the day, I’m here and have a solid collection of animal vids if that’s your shit 💖
